name: ide-apps-shared
description: Shared deps for every MCP under /opt/ide/apps/. Node's ESM resolver walks up node_modules from the importing module — broker-client.js lives here, so anything imported from it (undici for HTTPS_PROXY ProxyAgent, etc.) resolves from this directory's node_modules. Putting the dep here once avoids duplicating it in every MCP's package.json.
